snippet.title: Gran Turismo 7 - Power Pack Add-On Announcement Trailer | PS5 & PS4 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP9000-PPSA01317_00-GT7STD0000000PS5

Gran Turismo 7 fans, on December 4, 2025, the highly anticipated Power Pack DLC arrives for the PlayStation® 5 console available through the PS Store as a paid Add-On, delivering a brand-new game mode packed with authentic motorsport challenges.
